readiness_status: ML interface and handoff are internally validated and ready for team integration.

value.description: Numeric sensor measurement, or None for missing telemetry

functions.process_payload: process_backend_payload(service: MaitriMLService, payload: Union[Dict[str, Any], str]) -> Dict[str, Any]
functions.adapt_output: adapt_backend_output(output: Union[TelemetryInferenceOutput, Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]

missing_data_behavior.buffer_action: Flushes the sensor's rolling 30-step deque to prevent data gap distortions in reconstruction error.

invalid_data_behavior.non_finite_values: Intercepts NaN, +inf, -inf before neural network; safely routes to MISSING_DATA and resets rolling buffer.
invalid_data_behavior.schema_violation: Raises InvalidContractError if payload structure or datatypes fail contract validation.
invalid_data_behavior.unsupported_sensor: Raises UnsupportedSensorError if sensor_id is not in supported_sensors.

duplicate_behavior.rule: Rejected if (station_id, sensor_id, timestamp) matches the most recently processed timestamp for that sensor. Buffer is not duplicated or advanced.

stale_data_behavior.rule: Rejected if timestamp is older than the most recently recorded timestamp for that sensor. Preserves chronological buffer sequence.

data_basis: Synthetic telemetry exclusively. No real-world Antarctic telemetry was used or claimed.
person_a_responsibility: FastAPI backend and API route definitions
person_c_responsibility: Machine learning models (Z-score baseline & LSTM Autoencoder)
ML inference engine and 30-step window state management
ML validation, benchmarking, observability, and reliability hardening
Model registry and SHA-256 artifact integrity enforcement

known_limitations.synthetic_data_only: All models, thresholds, and evaluations are based strictly on synthetic telemetry. No real Antarctic telemetry was available or used.
known_limitations.no_field_claims: No claim of real-world Antarctic telemetry validation, field deployment readiness, production SLAs, or certified reliability is made.
known_limitations.false_positive_tradeoff: The frozen threshold (0.017674) prioritizes spike (100%) and drift (84.67%) recall, incurring a 48.15% FPR on normal diurnal synthetic fluctuations.
known_limitations.stuck_value_detection: STUCK_VALUE anomalies are not reliably detected by the single-threshold LSTM reconstruction loss alone (5% test recall; short stuck-value scenario evaluated as NORMAL in end-to-end test).

integration_sequence: Person A telemetry → backend adapter → TelemetryInput → MaitriMLService → LSTM inference → anomaly status → anomaly type → TelemetryInferenceOutput → backend adapter → backend JSON
bharati_status: Not started. Maitri is the completed Person C station scope.
